name: Ascend Wellness Holdings, Inc.
summary: Ascend Wellness Holdings, Inc. operates within the cannabis industry, specializing in the cultivation, processing, and distribution of packaged marijuana products. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a variety of cannabis forms, including dried flower, pre-rolled joints, concentrated extracts, vaporizable products, edibles, and other related consumer items. As of December 31, 2021, the company maintained a substantial retail presence, with 20 dispensaries in operation. Beyond its own network, Ascend Wellness Holdings additionally supplies its merchandise to other authorized cannabis retailers. Established in 2018, the firm's corporate headquarters are located in New York, New York.
